data.comment: Help menu item. {0} is the application name.

data.comment: Button that closes a dialog window.

data.name: Settings_Title
data.comment: Window title.

data.name: Settings_ComingSoon
data.value: Settings will appear here in a future release.

data.name: About_Title
data.comment: Window title. {0} is the application name.

data.name: About_Version
data.comment: {0} is a version number such as 0.6.2.

data.name: About_DevelopedBy
data.comment: {0} is the developer's name and callsign.

data.name: About_License
data.comment: {0} is the license name, e.g. GPL v3.

data.name: About_Website
data.comment: Link that opens the product web page in a browser.

data.name: About_SourceCode
data.comment: Link that opens the GitHub repository in a browser.

data.name: About_Channel
data.comment: {0} is the channel (alpha, beta, stable); {1} is a date like 2026-09-21.

data.name: About_Expires
data.comment: {0} is the channel; {1} is a date like 2026-10-21.

data.name: Expiry_TitleBar
data.comment: Appended to the window title on alpha and beta builds. {0} is a date.

data.name: Expiry_Warning
data.value: This {0} build expires in {1} day(s), on {2}. Download the current build from the Help menu.
data.comment: Status strip message in the final days before expiry. {0} channel, {1} number of days, {2} date.

data.name: Expiry_WarningToday
data.value: This {0} build expires today. Download the current build from the Help menu.
data.comment: Status strip message on the last day. {0} is the channel.

data.name: Expiry_BetaExpired
data.value: This beta build expired on {0}. It still runs, but a newer build is available.
data.comment: Status strip message on an expired beta. {0} is a date.

data.name: Expired_Title
data.comment: Window title of the dialog shown when an expired alpha is started. {0} is the app name.

data.name: Expired_Message
data.value:
This alpha build of {0} expired on {1}.
Alpha builds stop running after {2} days so that testers always use current code. Please download the latest build.
data.comment: {0} app name, {1} date, {2} number of days.

data.name: Expired_Download
data.comment: Button. Opens the releases page in a web browser.

data.name: Menu_HelpDownload
data.comment: Help menu item. Opens the releases page in a web browser.

data.name: FirstRun_Title
data.comment: Window title of the first-run dialog. {0} is the app name.

data.name: FirstRun_Intro
data.value: {0} can send anonymous diagnostic reports that help improve the radio and cable database for everyone.
data.comment: {0} is the app name.

data.name: Telemetry_Checkbox
data.comment: Checkbox label in the first-run dialog and in Settings.

data.name: Telemetry_WhatIsSent
data.value: What is sent: the {0} version and Windows version, whether Hamlib was found, and after each test run the radio model, serial settings, USB cable identifiers, and which tests passed or failed.
data.comment: {0} is the app name.

data.name: Telemetry_WhatIsNotSent
data.value: Never sent: your callsign, computer name, file paths, serial numbers, or IP address. The only identifier is a random ID created when you first ran the program.

data.name: Telemetry_ChangeLater
data.value: You can change this at any time in Settings, and see every report under Help.

data.name: Telemetry_PrivacyLink
data.comment: Link that opens the privacy policy in a web browser.

data.name: Common_Continue
data.comment: Button that closes the first-run dialog.

data.name: Settings_TelemetryHeading
data.comment: Section heading in Settings.

data.name: Settings_ViewData
data.comment: Button in Settings that opens the telemetry data viewer.

data.name: Menu_HelpViewData
data.comment: Help menu item. Opens the telemetry data viewer.

data.name: DataViewer_Title
data.comment: Window title.

data.name: DataViewer_Intro
data.value: Every diagnostic report this copy of {0} has sent or queued, newest first. Reports marked "pending" could not be sent yet and will be retried at the next start.
data.comment: {0} is the app name.

data.name: DataViewer_Empty
data.value: No reports have been created yet.

data.name: DataViewer_Clear
data.comment: Button. Deletes the locally stored report copies (does not affect what was already sent).

data.name: About_SupportId
data.comment: {0} is a random identifier. Users can quote it in support requests.

data.name: About_SupportIdHint
data.value: Quote this ID in a support request to match it with your diagnostic reports, if you have enabled them.

data.name: Common_Copy
data.comment: Button that copies text to the clipboard.

data.name: Crash_Title
data.comment: {0} is the app name.

data.name: Crash_Message
data.value:
{0} ran into an unexpected error and needs to close.
Details have been written to the log. If this keeps happening, please report it with the exported log attached.
data.comment: {0} is the app name.
